result.quote: But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.
result.reason: The key is directly supported by verse 9:53, but the window never identifies the city or tower as Thebez, so the question’s location premise is unsupported within the exact window. Also, “at Thebez tower” is unnatural; “at the tower in Thebez” would be clearer if that location were supplied.
